question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external-channel mirror setting, fold this workflow into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the behavior crosses privacy, authorization, session-state, and duplicate-delivery boundaries, so automation cannot choose the product/security policy safely.

options.title: Decide Under Origin-Delivery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship Narrow Default-Off Mirror Flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept separate WebChat mirroring semantics and require focused tests plus live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery Only
options.body: Decline automatic mirroring if maintainers decide Control UI should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-message delivery route.

recommendation.title: Decide Under Origin-Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the live issue and is the clearest available owner for the product/security routing choice.
